drafts.title: [TEST] LegoraBot bridge check
drafts.body:
🧪 **This is a test draft for LegoraBot.** If you can read it in the review form, the bridge between Claude and the bot works.

**What this test checks**

- Claude writes a draft into the public repository [Femapu/Legora](https://github.com/Femapu/Legora)
- LegoraBot fetches `inbox.json`, imports the draft and puts it in the queue
- The moderator receives a modmail notification and reviews the post

**Formatting check**

- **Bold**, *italic* and [a link to Legora's product pages](https://legora.com/product/agent)
- Bullet lists and paragraphs

Discard this draft after the test: it is not meant to be published.
